findings.reason: a node implementing §8 against §5's partition would ship a change-detector that cannot see its own events, and the fix is a sentence naming the heartbeat as the wake source (or moving the events into the main database), not a re-implementation of the subscriber.
findings.text: §5 writes events to one file per UTC day "attached for reads", but §8 wakes on `PRAGMA data_version`, and that pragma reports changes only to the main database: measured in this workspace with a positive control, a second connection's commit to the ATTACHED day file left the reader's value at 2 while the same commit to the main file moved it (1→2), and the attached row was readable — so the detector the subscriber is built on is blind to the writes it waits for, and delivery only works because §7's every-tick heartbeat write happens to land in the main database, a dependency the plan never states

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every href in the plan resolves (`docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html`, `docs/plans/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches.html`, `docs/evidence/archive/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once-landed.html#s4` exists) and each cited symbol resolves as written: `_session_host_runtime_root` (reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:481, three candidates in the stated order), `_filesystem_type` and `_SHARED_FILESYSTEMS` (reckon/host.py:157, :51 with eight entries), `reckon/host.py:190`–`192` (the `_is_node_local_path` prefix acceptance that precedes the mount-type return, reckon/host.py:190–192), `file_memo.file_signature` (reckon/file_memo.py:270), and the registry the plan says the store's error does not join (D-keyed `DISPATCH_REFUSAL_REMEDIES`, reckon/crew/refusals.py:18).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §5's gate names two mutation controls (an undated events file must fail the retention test; a store routed through `host._is_node_local` must fail the shared-type case) and §7's names one (a station without the node lock, started twice, must fail the "each transition once" test), so each changed unit names a control that can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the only node-local paths either changed unit names are the store's own live state under the runtime root, which §9 exports to the crew home by atomic replace; no gate log or evidence file is placed in a scratchpad or a per-run temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed text carries no plan label, ticket number or version tag, and the rejection of the `station-store-not-node-local` registry entry leaves no stage-labelled symbol behind.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5 partitions events into per-day attached files while §8 detects new rows with `PRAGMA data_version`, which does not move for a commit made by another connection to an attached database.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 delivers one module and §7 one verb, with the producer retirement explicitly deferred to §12.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §5, §6 and §7 form the declared chain (`s6`←`s5`, `s7`←`s6`) and the live open followup agrees with it, so nothing in the changed units needs a relationship the plan does not already declare.
